blocking_finding.finding: The current runtime harness records pactl short sink/source lines and only a SHA256 of the complete pw-dump text. It does not extract and persist the exact PipeWire object.serial/object.id binding for the named run-owned sink and its monitor. Issue 912 and the current Trigger7 S2 preflight explicitly require exact sink + monitor node identities/object.serial values. A whole-dump hash without the mapped object records cannot later prove which PipeWire objects corresponded to the measured sink/monitor.

smallest_required_repair: Parse pw-dump JSON after null-sink creation.
Resolve the exact node/object for sink_name=f2_voice_g2_sink and monitor_name=f2_voice_g2_sink.monitor using stable properties such as node.name/media.class plus the same names enumerated by pactl.

Persist for each resolved object at minimum object.id/id, object.serial, node.name, media.class, device.id if present, and the exact relevant JSON object or a canonical hash plus the canonical fields themselves.
Fail closed before CONTROL if either object cannot be resolved uniquely or object.serial is absent/ambiguous.
After unload/cleanup, prove those same resolved identities/names are absent; do not infer cleanup only from substring absence in a generic list if a stronger identity check is available.
Keep the existing whole pw-dump hash as supplemental graph identity, not as a substitute for object binding.

runtime_identity_hardening.finding: The launch path pins Piper model/config hashes and piper-tts package version in the install command, but the promotion receipt currently does not persist the observed TTS runtime package/version or Python environment identity. Current G2 asks for TTS runtime/model identity, so observed runtime version should be emitted rather than inferred from launcher source.
smallest_required_repair: Record observed piper-tts version from importlib.metadata or pip metadata inside the exact venv used for synthesis.
Record Python version and, where material to waveform generation, numpy/soundfile versions.
Keep exact generated run-local source.wav SHA256 and bind identical bytes to CONTROL and CANCEL; do not resurrect vanished historical WAV identity.

causal_scope_note.finding: The harness calls VoicePacketCortex.cancel_for_barge_in(), verifies the bound output became interrupted/non-commit-eligible, and only then terminates the paplay process. This is acceptable only at the bounded test-driver translation scope unless current product source already defines that exact packet-cancel -> playback-process termination bridge. Do not describe a PASS as proving an autonomous production playback executor if the runtime harness itself performs stop_playback().
causal_scope_note.required_scope_fence: PASS may prove the measured packet-fence plus explicitly test-driven PipeWire transport cancellation/readback boundary. It must not silently mint a broader production playback/effect authority claim.

do_not_change: Do not create a second VoicePacketCortex, playback authority, state authority, effect authority or semantic G2 owner.
Do not reopen G3 while G2 is current/nonterminal.
Do not convert a missing identity field into PRODUCT_NEGATIVE; it is EVIDENCE_INVALID until repaired.
next_exact_action: Trigger4 current singleton for issue 912 should fold the identity-binding repair into the existing G2 S2 harness before or as a required-repair descendant of any promotion-bearing dispatch. Then execute exactly one current repaired subject. If a run already started on the pre-repair subject, preserve it as historical/insufficient-at-object-serial-scope and do not compose its runtime with repaired source without explicit semantic invariance/evidence validity.
